en: A color postcard showing a small rural town in a wide green valley surrounded by steep, rocky, forested mountains. In the foreground there are orchards and cultivated fields laid out in rows. The middle ground has scattered light‑colored houses with red or brown tiled roofs, a low industrial building, and electric poles. Further back, a clustered village with a church tower stands at the base of a hillside. The sky is bright blue with wispy clouds. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
